domains.reason: Terminal run throughput is measured through the durable invocation read model rather than raw run-event transport.
Episode recurrence is exposed by the bounded run episodes measure and will be aggregated by episode cohorts.

omitted.reason: Run events are append-only investigation evidence, not an independently meaningful historical business entity. Operators use the bounded per-run report, events, tools, and aggregate run-stats queries; a time-windowed event-count measure would only restate transport volume and risk optimizing for noisy telemetry rather than run outcomes.
The types schema contains shared enums and value objects, not independently persisted records. It has no historical count whose optimization would improve Agent Manager behavior.
Profiles are long-lived configuration records; this plan measures execution friction and throughput, not configuration inventory.
Tasks are work definitions, not execution evidence; run throughput is measured on the durable terminal run projection.
Workflow definitions and runtime bookkeeping are outside the friction and throughput measurement surface of this plan.
Profile rows are configuration inventory and are intentionally not counted as a historical optimization signal.
Artifacts are per-run outputs inspected through the run report; artifact row volume is not an outcome measure.
Idempotency records are transport safeguards, not domain outcomes.
This is the durable substrate backing the declared run throughput measures, not a separate business domain.
Manual pricing overrides are administrative configuration; cost is measured from durable terminal run facts.
Model aliases are lookup configuration, not historical execution evidence.
Pricing rows are lookup configuration; measured cost is captured on terminal runs.
Policy records are authorization configuration, not a friction or throughput outcome.
Finding recurrence is declared as a fingerprint aggregate; a raw finding-row inventory count would be a separate, misleading measure.
Workflow runtime lifecycle is outside this run-level friction analytics scope.
Workflow journals are append-only runtime diagnostics, not independently meaningful historical outcomes.
Workflow node attempts are implementation detail for workflow orchestration, outside the run analytical corpus.
Workflow revisions are versioned definitions, not execution outcomes.
Price-book revisions are immutable pricing provenance used by charge projection; their row inventory is not an operator outcome measure.
Subscription periods are billing allocation facts consumed by charge queries; their row inventory is not an operator outcome measure.
